mapper.sql: SELECT k.kit_id, k.kit_no, k.work_order_id, k.work_order_no, k.mps_id, k.mps_no, k.bom_id, b.bom_no, k.check_time, k.kit_rate, k.is_complete, k.status, k.del_flag, k.create_by, k.create_time, k.update_by, k.update_time, k.remark FROM mms_kit_check k LEFT JOIN mms_bom b ON k.bom_id = b.bom_id

mapper.update: UPDATE mms_kit_check SET kit_no = #{kitNo}, work_order_id = #{workOrderId}, work_order_no = #{workOrderNo}, mps_id = #{mpsId}, mps_no = #{mpsNo}, bom_id = #{bomId}, check_time = #{checkTime}, kit_rate = #{kitRate}, is_complete = #{isComplete}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, remark = #{remark} WHERE kit_id = #{kitId}
